description: Tool and API failures of Claude Code prompts, from OTel log events: counts, reasons, error statuses and the latest failures.

links.title: Claude Working Time
links.tooltip: How long Claude Code worked for each engineer, per repository and workday. That dashboard uses your browser's timezone where this one uses UTC, so a relative range such as Today covers your local day there

panels.description: Number of failed tool calls (tool results that reported an error) that happened in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Tool failures"
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  AND f.failure_kind = 'tool_error'

panels.title: API Errors

panels.description: Share of active prompts with at least one API error or failed tool call. A prompt counts as active if it started in the time range or had a failure in it; failures count by when they happened.

targets.rawSql:
-- Failures count by when they happened, like the other failure panels. The share is of the
-- prompts active in the range: those that started in it or had a failure in it. The two halves
-- of the UNION each use their own time index; an OR across the two tables would scan every prompt.
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.failed) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS "Prompts with a failure"
FROM (
  SELECT u.id, MAX(u.failed) AS failed
  FROM (
    SELECT p.id, 0 AS failed FROM ai_prompts p WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT f.ai_prompt_id, 1 FROM ai_prompt_failures f WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  ) u
  GROUP BY u.id
) a
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = a.id
WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Failed Prompts

panels.description: The most frequent failure reason in the time range, across tool failures and API errors; the count is not shown. Tool failures are labelled by tool and error type, API errors by HTTP status, or by error type or the start of the message (request ids removed) when there is no status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.reason AS "Top failure reason"
FROM (
  SELECT CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN CONCAT('API ', COALESCE(CONCAT(f.status_code, ' ', CASE f.status_code WHEN 400 THEN 'Bad request' WHEN 401 THEN 'Unauthorized' WHEN 403 THEN 'Forbidden' WHEN 404 THEN 'Not found' WHEN 413 THEN 'Request too large' WHEN 429 THEN 'Rate limited' WHEN 500 THEN 'Server error' WHEN 503 THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN 529 THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Error' END), NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), NULLIF(TRIM(LEFT(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.error_message, 'req_[A-Za-z0-9]+', '')), 60)), ''), 'Unknown')) ELSE CONCAT(f.tool_name, ' · ', COALESCE(NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), 'Unknown')) END AS reason, COUNT(*) AS failures
  FROM ai_prompt_failures f
  JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY failures DESC, reason
  LIMIT 1
) r

panels.title: Top Failure

    COUNT(*) AS errors
  FROM ai_prompt_failures f
  JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Top API Error

panels.description: Failures per UTC day, stacked by reason. Tool failures are labelled by tool and error type; API errors by HTTP status, or by error type or the start of the message when there is no status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(f.occurred_at)) AS time,
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN CONCAT('API ', COALESCE(CONCAT(f.status_code, ' ', CASE f.status_code WHEN 400 THEN 'Bad request' WHEN 401 THEN 'Unauthorized' WHEN 403 THEN 'Forbidden' WHEN 404 THEN 'Not found' WHEN 413 THEN 'Request too large' WHEN 429 THEN 'Rate limited' WHEN 500 THEN 'Server error' WHEN 503 THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN 529 THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Error' END), NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), NULLIF(TRIM(LEFT(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.error_message, 'req_[A-Za-z0-9]+', '')), 60)), ''), 'Unknown')) ELSE CONCAT(f.tool_name, ' · ', COALESCE(NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), 'Unknown')) END AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Failures per Day by Reason

panels.description: API errors grouped by model and error, with failure, prompt and engineer counts and when each last happened, most frequent first. Error is the HTTP status, or the error type or start of the message (request ids removed) when there is no status. Example message is one stored message for that group.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 1)), SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 2)) AS "Model",
  COALESCE(CONCAT(f.status_code, ' ', CASE f.status_code WHEN 400 THEN 'Bad request' WHEN 401 THEN 'Unauthorized' WHEN 403 THEN 'Forbidden' WHEN 404 THEN 'Not found' WHEN 413 THEN 'Request too large' WHEN 429 THEN 'Rate limited' WHEN 500 THEN 'Server error' WHEN 503 THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN 529 THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Error' END), NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), NULLIF(TRIM(LEFT(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.error_message, 'req_[A-Za-z0-9]+', '')), 60)), ''), 'Unknown') AS "Error",
  -- Messages can carry request ids, so one example stands in for the reason's messages.
  MAX(NULLIF(f.error_message, '')) AS "Example message",
  COUNT(*) AS "Failures",
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.ai_prompt_id) AS "Prompts",
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)) AS "Engineers",
  MAX(f.occurred_at) AS "Last seen"
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  AND f.failure_kind = 'api_error'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1, 2

panels.title: Top Tool Failure Reasons

panels.description: API errors grouped by HTTP status (N/A when there was none), model and source, with error and prompt counts, the average and highest retry attempt that failed, and when each last happened. Source is the main conversation, a subagent, or background work such as session titles.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(f.status_code AS CHAR), 'N/A') AS "Status",
  CASE WHEN f.model LIKE 'claude-%' THEN CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 1)), SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 2)) ELSE f.model END AS "Model",
  CASE WHEN f.failure_kind <> 'api_error' THEN '' WHEN f.query_source = 'repl_main_thread' THEN 'Main conversation' WHEN f.query_source LIKE 'agent:%' THEN CONCAT('Subagent (', SUBSTRING_INDEX(f.query_source, ':', -1), ')') WHEN f.query_source = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE CONCAT('Background (', f.query_source, ')') END AS "Source",
  COUNT(*) AS "Errors",
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.ai_prompt_id) AS "Prompts",
  AVG(f.attempt) AS "Avg attempt",
  MAX(f.attempt) AS "Max attempt",
  MAX(f.occurred_at) AS "Last seen"
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  AND f.failure_kind = 'api_error'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1, 2, 3

panels.title: API Errors by Status and Model

panels.description: The latest 200 API errors in the time range, newest first, with engineer, repository, model, error, full message, source and request duration. Repository is gh/, gl/ or bb/ plus owner/repo (other hosts keep their host name) and links to the repository.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.occurred_at AS "Time",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''), NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS "Engineer",
  CASE
    WHEN p.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN p.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(p.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'gh/')
    WHEN p.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(p.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'gl/')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN p.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(p.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'bb/')
    -- Any other host keeps its host name in front of the path.
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(p.repository_url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS "Repository",
  CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 1)), SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 2)) AS "Model",
  COALESCE(CONCAT(f.status_code, ' ', CASE f.status_code WHEN 400 THEN 'Bad request' WHEN 401 THEN 'Unauthorized' WHEN 403 THEN 'Forbidden' WHEN 404 THEN 'Not found' WHEN 413 THEN 'Request too large' WHEN 429 THEN 'Rate limited' WHEN 500 THEN 'Server error' WHEN 503 THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN 529 THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Error' END), NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), NULLIF(TRIM(LEFT(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.error_message, 'req_[A-Za-z0-9]+', '')), 60)), ''), 'Unknown') AS "Error",
  NULLIF(f.error_message, '') AS "Message",
  CASE WHEN f.query_source = 'repl_main_thread' THEN 'Main conversation' WHEN f.query_source LIKE 'agent:%' THEN CONCAT('Subagent (', SUBSTRING_INDEX(f.query_source, ':', -1), ')') WHEN f.query_source = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE CONCAT('Background (', f.query_source, ')') END AS "Source",
  f.duration_ms AS "Duration",
  -- repository_link is empty for prompts without a repository, so their Repository cell has no link.
  COALESCE(p.repository_url, '') AS repository_link
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
-- account_id is the user's DevLake account, which carries the full name.
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  AND f.failure_kind = 'api_error'
ORDER BY f.occurred_at DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Recent Tool Failures

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

list.definition:
-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,

-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
